name: Whirlpool Freestanding Range Oven RTD
purpose: Verify main oven temperature sensor (RTD) at room temp per W11746350 P22 and W11174426 P3/Con3 charts.
failureModes: Open (OL): F3E0 sensor fault — bake/broil may lock out
Short to chassis or reading far outside range: drift or damaged harness
testingTips: Measure with oven fully cooled; disconnect sensor from ACU before Ω check
W11746350: P22-1 to P22-2; LCX: P3-4 to P3-5; LCC: Con 3-9 to Con 3-10
notes: Resistance rises with temperature — baseline 1000–1200 Ω at room temp per Whirlpool freestanding range manuals

name: Whirlpool Freestanding Range Door Latch Motor
purpose: Verify rear door latch motor winding for self-clean lock failures (F5E0/F5E1).
failureModes: Open winding: latch motor will not cycle in Clean mode
Out of range: motor or latch assembly failure
testingTips: Disconnect leads before measuring; W11746350 P8-5 to P8-6; LCX P2-3 to P1-3 WH; LCC Con 1-4 to Con 1-1 W
Use Component Activation / Clean keypad in Diagnostics to verify latch cycles after repair

name: Whirlpool Freestanding Hidden Bake Element (W11746350)
purpose: Hidden main-cavity bake element cold resistance per W11746350 — 23.3 Ω ±5% at P4-3 to P4-4.
failureModes: Open (OL): no bake heat, FEE6 path
Grounded or far outside range: shorted/damaged element
testingTips: LCX/LCC models in W11174426 use 10–40 Ω nominal — use bakeElementOhms for those procedures

name: Whirlpool Freestanding Convection Element (gas oven)
purpose: Gas-range convection assist element — 14.5–16.1 Ω cold per W11746350 (914 W heated).
failureModes: Open element: no convection heat on gas models with fan assist
Confounded with broil on some non-convect models — verify model features
testingTips: Convection fan motor separate check: ~85 Ω ±10% on W11746350; 15–20 Ω on LCX/LCC electric charts

name: Whirlpool Freestanding Convection Fan Motor (W11746350)
purpose: Convection fan motor winding — 85 Ω ±10% cold per W11746350 Component Testing.
testingTips: LCX electric models spec 15–20 Ω — different motor; verify against tech sheet

name: Whirlpool Freestanding DSI Gas Valve Coil
purpose: Direct Spark Ignition (DSI) board gas valve / regulator solenoid — 216 Ω ±10% per W11746350 and W11174426 charts.
failureModes: Open coil: no gas to bake or broil burner
Good Ω but no flame: igniter, flame rectification, or gas supply
testingTips: W11174426: J1-1 to J1-2 in Bake mode; J1-3 to J1-2 in Broil mode
W11746350 gas regulator solenoid terminals also 216 Ω ±10%
Verify 120 VAC to DSI and 8–18 VDC flame sense when burner lit

name: Whirlpool Freestanding Bridge Element (outer)
purpose: Bridge cooktop element outer section — 68.5 Ω ±5% cold per W11746350.
failureModes: Open outer section: partial or no heat on bridge burner
testingTips: Disconnect leads before measuring each section
Measure outer and inner elements independently

name: Whirlpool Freestanding Bridge Element (inner)
purpose: Bridge cooktop element inner section — 30.5 Ω ±5% cold per W11746350.
failureModes: Open inner section: bridge burner weak or one ring dead
testingTips: Pair with outer section measurement on same bridge element

name: Whirlpool Freestanding Single Cooktop Element
purpose: Single radiant cooktop element — 45.7 Ω ±5% cold per W11746350.
failureModes: Open element: no heat on affected burner
testingTips: Disconnect leads at element before measuring

name: Whirlpool Freestanding Warming Zone Element
purpose: Warming zone element — 145 Ω ±5% cold per W11746350.

name: Whirlpool Freestanding Oven Light Bulb
purpose: Oven incandescent light assembly — 0–40 Ω nominal per W11746350 and W11174426 charts.
failureModes: Open (OL): burned-out bulb or bad socket
Measure with light switch off and door closed for resistance check
testingTips: LCC: Con 1-5 BK to Con 1-1 W; LCX: P2-1 to P1-3 WH
